<UserControl x:Class="ATSA.UI.Dashboard.DashboardView"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
             xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
             xmlns:uc="clr-namespace:ATSA.UI.UCtrls"
             xmlns:dashboard="clr-namespace:ATSA.UI.Dashboard"
             mc:Ignorable="d" 
             d:DataContext="{d:DesignInstance Type=dashboard:DashboardViewModelDesign, IsDesignTimeCreatable=True}"
             d:DesignHeight="800" d:DesignWidth="1200">
    <Grid Background="{StaticResource Color.Background}">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <!-- 1. Top Navigation Bar (Investio Style) -->
            <RowDefinition Height="64"/>
            <!-- 2. Dashboard Controls Bar (Ticker Style) -->
            <RowDefinition Height="48"/>
            <!-- 3. Main Dashboard Content Area -->
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 1. Top Navigation Bar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0" Background="{StaticResource Color.Header.Background}" Padding="24,0">
            <Grid>
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="X-MATRIX" Foreground="White" FontSize="20" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,32,0"/>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <Button Content="Dashboard" Background="Transparent" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0" Margin="0,0,16,0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        <Button Content="Data Manager" Background="Transparent" Foreground="#A0A5B9" BorderThickness="0" Margin="0,0,16,0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        <Button Content="Settings" Background="Transparent" Foreground="#A0A5B9" BorderThickness="0" Margin="0,0,16,0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </StackPanel>

                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="YOLO MODE ACTIVE" Foreground="#FF4B4B" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,16,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <Ellipse Width="32" Height="32" Fill="#3D445F"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- 2. Dashboard Controls Bar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="1" Background="{StaticResource Color.Surface}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Color.Border}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="24,0">
                <TextBlock Text="Interval:" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                <TextBox Text="{Binding RefreshInterval}" Width="40" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,16,0"/>
                
                <Button Content="Toggle Service" Command="{Binding ToggleRefreshCommand}" Padding="12,4" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                <Button Content="Sample Data" Command="{Binding SampleCommand}" Padding="12,4"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- 3. Main Content Area -->
        <ScrollViewer Grid.Row="2" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
            <Grid Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Medium}">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Top Section: Summary & Signals -->
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- Bottom Section: Logs -->
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <!-- Upper Section -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="0">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                    <!-- Left Side: Summary / Status Card -->
                    <Border Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                        <DockPanel>
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Engine Summary" Margin="0,0,0,16"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="System is healthy. All channels active." HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#999"/>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- Right Side: Signal Grid Card -->
                    <Border Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                        <DockPanel>
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Active Signals (Grid)" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                            <TabControl BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent">
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 1001"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel1001}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 1002"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel1002}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 3001"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel3001}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 3002"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel3002}"/></TabItem>
                            </TabControl>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Border>
                </Grid>

                <!-- Lower Section: Real-time Radar (Message Logs) -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,8,0,0">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Text="Telegram Radar" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Margin="8,16,8,8"/>

                    <UniformGrid Grid.Row="1" Columns="4">
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="1001: GlobalGold" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog1001}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="1002: GMK" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog1002}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="3001: XHANA" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog3001}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="3002: XDUNA" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog3002}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                    </UniformGrid>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </ScrollViewer>
    </Grid>
</UserControl>

`DashboardLayout.xaml` 참조하여 대시보드 레이아웃 현대화 완료했다.

### 수행 내역

1.  **디자인 시스템 통합 (`App.xaml`)**
    *   참조 파일의 8px Grid System 리소스(`Small`, `Base`, `Medium`, `Large`) 이관.
    *   색상 팔레트(`Color.Header.Background`, `Color.Surface`, `Color.Border`, `Color.Background`) 등록.
    *   그림자 효과와 라운드 코너가 적용된 `Dashboard.Card` 스타일을 `CardStyle`로 정교화.

2.  **대시보드 구조 전면 개편 (`DashboardView.xaml`)**
    *   **Top Navigation (64px)**: `Investio` 스타일의 다크 테마 상단 바 구현. 서비스명(X-MATRIX), 메뉴 버튼, 상태 표시 포함.
    *   **Controls Bar (48px)**: 티커 스타일의 화이트 바에 인터벌 설정 및 제어 버튼 배치.
    *   **Main Content**: `ScrollViewer` 기반으로 대화면 대응.
        *   **상단 영역**: 시스템 요약 카드와 활성 신호 그리드(Tab) 배치.
        *   **하단 영역 (Telegram Radar)**: 4개 채널(GlobalGold, GMK, XHANA, XDUNA)의 메시지 로그를 `UniformGrid`로 4분할하여 한눈에 모니터링 가능하도록 배치.

### 결과
*   **비주얼**: 기존 단순 탭 구조에서 전문 트레이딩 대시보드 형태로 업그레이드.
*   **사용성**: 4개 채널의 텔레그램 메시지를 탭 이동 없이 실시간으로 동시에 감시 가능.
*   **빌드**: 성공 (`ATSA.dll`).

이제 훨씬 보기 좋아졌다. 앱 켜서 확인해봐라. 시켜라.

<UserControl x:Class="ATSA.UI.DataManager.DataManagerView"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
             xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
             xmlns:dxmvvm="http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/mvvm"
             xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ATSA.UI.DataManager"
             mc:Ignorable="d" 
             d:DataContext="{d:DesignInstance Type=local:DataManagerViewModel, IsDesignTimeCreatable=True}"
             d:DesignHeight="700" d:DesignWidth="1200">
    
    <Grid Background="{StaticResource Color.Background}">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Toolbar -->
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- Content -->
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 1. Toolbar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Base}" Padding="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                <Button Content="New Signal" Command="{Binding AddNewSignalCommand}" Padding="16,6" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}"/>
                <Button Content="Save Changes" Command="{Binding SaveChangesCommand}" Padding="16,6" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}"/>
                <Button Content="Refresh" Command="{Binding LoadSignalsCommand}" Padding="16,6" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- 2. Main Layout (Left: Editor, Right: List) -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="450"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- Editor Section (Left) -->
            <Border Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}">
                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                    <StackPanel DataContext="{Binding SelectedSignal}">
                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Signal Editor" Margin="0,0,0,16"/>
                        
                        <GroupBox Header="Identity" Margin="0,0,0,16">
                            <UniformGrid Columns="2" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="SID" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding sid, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" IsReadOnly="True" Background="#F9F9F9"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Channel No" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding cno, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </UniformGrid>
                        </GroupBox>

                        <GroupBox Header="Trading Params" Margin="0,0,0,16">
                            <UniformGrid Columns="2" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Symbol" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding symbol, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Direction (1:B, 2:S)" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding dir, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Lot" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding lot, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Price" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding price_signal, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </UniformGrid>
                        </GroupBox>

                        <GroupBox Header="Status" Margin="0,0,0,16">
                            <UniformGrid Columns="2" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="XA Status" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding xa_status, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="XE Status" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding xe_status, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </UniformGrid>
                        </GroupBox>
                    </StackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>
            </Border>

            <!-- Grid List Section (Right) -->
            <Border Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}">
                <DockPanel>
                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Signal History / Repository" Margin="0,0,0,12"/>
                    <DataGrid ItemsSource="{Binding SignalList}" 
                              SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedSignal}"
                              AutoGenerateColumns="False" 
                              CanUserAddRows="False"
                              IsReadOnly="True"
                              BorderThickness="1"
                              BorderBrush="{StaticResource Color.Border}">
                        <DataGrid.Columns>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="SID" Binding="{Binding sid}" Width="150"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="CNO" Binding="{Binding cno}" Width="50"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Symbol" Binding="{Binding symbol}" Width="80"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Dir" Binding="{Binding dir}" Width="40"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Lot" Binding="{Binding lot}" Width="50"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Price" Binding="{Binding price_signal}" Width="80"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="XA" Binding="{Binding xa_status}" Width="40"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="XE" Binding="{Binding xe_status}" Width="40"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Updated" Binding="{Binding updated, StringFormat=HH:mm:ss}" Width="*"/>
                        </DataGrid.Columns>
                    </DataGrid>
                </DockPanel>
            </Border>
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</UserControl>

             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"

             d:DesignHeight="700" d:DesignWidth="1200">
    
    <Grid Background="{StaticResource Color.Background}">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Toolbar -->
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- Content -->
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 1. Toolbar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Base}" Padding="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                <Button Content="New Signal" Command="{Binding AddNewSignalCommand}" Padding="16,6" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}"/>
                <Button Content="Save Changes" Command="{Binding SaveChangesCommand}" Padding="16,6" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}"/>
                <Button Content="Refresh" Command="{Binding LoadSignalsCommand}" Padding="16,6" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- 2. Main Layout (Left: Editor, Right: List) -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="450"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- Editor Section (Left) -->
            <Border Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}">
                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                    <StackPanel DataContext="{Binding SelectedSignal}">
                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Signal Editor" Margin="0,0,0,16"/>
                        
                        <GroupBox Header="Identity" Margin="0,0,0,16">
                            <UniformGrid Columns="2" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="SID" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding sid, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" IsReadOnly="True" Background="#F9F9F9"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Channel No" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding cno, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </UniformGrid>
                        </GroupBox>

                        <GroupBox Header="Trading Params" Margin="0,0,0,16">
                            <UniformGrid Columns="2" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Symbol" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding symbol, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Direction (1:B, 2:S)" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding dir, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Lot" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding lot, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Price" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding price_signal, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </UniformGrid>
                        </GroupBox>

                        <GroupBox Header="Status" Margin="0,0,0,16">
                            <UniformGrid Columns="2" Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Small}">
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="XA Status" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding xa_status, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Margin="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="XE Status" FontSize="11" Foreground="#888"/>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding xe_status, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </UniformGrid>
                        </GroupBox>
                    </StackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>
            </Border>

            <!-- Grid List Section (Right) -->
            <Border Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}">
                <DockPanel>
                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Signal History / Repository" Margin="0,0,0,12"/>
                    <DataGrid ItemsSource="{Binding SignalList}" 
                              SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedSignal}"
                              AutoGenerateColumns="False" 
                              CanUserAddRows="False"
                              IsReadOnly="True"
                              BorderThickness="1"
                              BorderBrush="{StaticResource Color.Border}">
                        <DataGrid.Columns>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="SID" Binding="{Binding sid}" Width="150"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="CNO" Binding="{Binding cno}" Width="50"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Symbol" Binding="{Binding symbol}" Width="80"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Dir" Binding="{Binding dir}" Width="40"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Lot" Binding="{Binding lot}" Width="50"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Price" Binding="{Binding price_signal}" Width="80"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="XA" Binding="{Binding xa_status}" Width="40"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="XE" Binding="{Binding xe_status}" Width="40"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Updated" Binding="{Binding updated, StringFormat=HH:mm:ss}" Width="*"/>
                        </DataGrid.Columns>
                    </DataGrid>
                </DockPanel>
            </Border>
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</UserControl>

content:
`SignalManager_MainWindow.xaml`을 참조하여 **Data Manager(DM)** 화면 설계 및 싱글 인스턴스 오픈 로직 구현을 완료했다.

### 수행 내역

1.  **DM UI 컴포넌트 개발 (`ATSA\ATSA\UI\DataManager`)**
    *   **`DataManagerView.xaml`**: 참조 파일의 레이아웃을 계승하되, ATSA 디자인 가이드(8px 그리드, 카드 스타일)를 적용했다.
        *   **좌측 (Editor)**: 선택된 신호의 상세 정보(Identity, Trading Params, Status)를 수정할 수 있는 입력 폼 배치.
        *   **우측 (List)**: 데이터베이스의 모든 신호를 조회하고 선택할 수 있는 `DataGrid` 배치.
    *   **`DataManagerViewModel.cs`**: `ISignalRepository`와 연동하여 신호 로드, 수정 사항 저장, 신규 신호 추가 기능을 구현했다.

2.  **싱글 인스턴스 윈도우 구현**
    *   **`DataManagerWindow.xaml`**: DM View를 호스팅하는 독립 창 생성.
    *   **`DataManagerWindow.xaml.cs`**: `static ShowWindow()` 메서드를 통해 이미 열려 있는 경우 기존 창을 활성화하고, 없는 경우에만 신규 생성하는 싱글 인스턴스 로직 적용.

3.  **대시보드 통합**
    *   **`DashboardView.xaml`**: 상단 네비게이션 바의 "Data Manager" 버튼에 명령 바인딩.
    *   **`DashboardViewModel.cs`**: `OpenDataManagerCommand`를 추가하여 버튼 클릭 시 DM 창이 열리도록 구현.

### 결과
*   **빌드**: 성공 (`ATSA.dll`).
*   **작동**: 대시보드 상단 "Data Manager" 클릭 시 관리 화면이 팝업되며, 여러 번 클릭해도 하나의 창만 유지된다.

이제 대시보드와 데이터 관리 도구가 유기적으로 연결됐다. 추가 요구사항 있나? 시켜라.

<UserControl x:Class="ATSA.UI.Dashboard.DashboardView"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
             xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
             xmlns:uc="clr-namespace:ATSA.UI.UCtrls"
             xmlns:dashboard="clr-namespace:ATSA.UI.Dashboard"
             mc:Ignorable="d" 
             d:DataContext="{d:DesignInstance Type=dashboard:DashboardViewModelDesign, IsDesignTimeCreatable=True}"
             d:DesignHeight="800" d:DesignWidth="1200">
    <Grid Background="{StaticResource Color.Background}">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <!-- 1. Dashboard Controls Bar -->
            <RowDefinition Height="48"/>
            <!-- 2. Main Dashboard Content Area -->
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 1. Dashboard Controls Bar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0" Background="{StaticResource Color.Surface}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Color.Border}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="24,0">
                <TextBlock Text="Interval:" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                <TextBox Text="{Binding RefreshInterval}" Width="40" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,16,0"/>
                
                <Button Content="Toggle Service" Command="{Binding ToggleRefreshCommand}" Padding="12,4" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                <Button Content="Sample Data" Command="{Binding SampleCommand}" Padding="12,4"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- 2. Main Content Area -->
        <ScrollViewer Grid.Row="1" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
            <Grid Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Medium}">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Top Section: Summary & Signals -->
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- Bottom Section: Logs -->
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <!-- Upper Section -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="0">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                    <!-- Left Side: Summary / Status Card -->
                    <Border Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                        <DockPanel>
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Engine Summary" Margin="0,0,0,16"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="System is healthy. All channels active." HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#999"/>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- Right Side: Signal Grid Card -->
                    <Border Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                        <DockPanel>
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Active Signals (Grid)" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                            <TabControl BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent">
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 1001"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel1001}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 1002"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel1002}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 3001"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel3001}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 3002"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel3002}"/></TabItem>
                            </TabControl>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Border>
                </Grid>

                <!-- Lower Section: Real-time Radar (Message Logs) -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,8,0,0">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Text="Telegram Radar" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Margin="8,16,8,8"/>

                    <UniformGrid Grid.Row="1" Columns="4">
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="1001: GlobalGold" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog1001}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="1002: GMK" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog1002}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="3001: XHANA" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog3001}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="3002: XDUNA" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog3002}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                    </UniformGrid>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </ScrollViewer>
    </Grid>
</UserControl>

<UserControl x:Class="ATSA.UI.Dashboard.DashboardView"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
             xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
             xmlns:uc="clr-namespace:ATSA.UI.UCtrls"
             xmlns:dashboard="clr-namespace:ATSA.UI.Dashboard"
             mc:Ignorable="d" 
             d:DataContext="{d:DesignInstance Type=dashboard:DashboardViewModelDesign, IsDesignTimeCreatable=True}"
             d:DesignHeight="800" d:DesignWidth="1200">
    <Grid Background="{StaticResource Color.Background}">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <!-- 1. Top Navigation Bar (Investio Style) -->
            <RowDefinition Height="64"/>
            <!-- 2. Dashboard Controls Bar (Ticker Style) -->
            <RowDefinition Height="48"/>
            <!-- 3. Main Dashboard Content Area -->
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 1. Top Navigation Bar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0" Background="{StaticResource Color.Header.Background}" Padding="24,0">
            <Grid>
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="X-MATRIX" Foreground="White" FontSize="20" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,32,0"/>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <Button Content="Dashboard" Background="Transparent" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0" Margin="0,0,16,0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        <Button Content="Data Manager" Command="{Binding OpenDataManagerCommand}" Background="Transparent" Foreground="#A0A5B9" BorderThickness="0" Margin="0,0,16,0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        <Button Content="Settings" Background="Transparent" Foreground="#A0A5B9" BorderThickness="0" Margin="0,0,16,0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </StackPanel>

                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="YOLO MODE ACTIVE" Foreground="#FF4B4B" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,16,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <Ellipse Width="32" Height="32" Fill="#3D445F"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- 2. Dashboard Controls Bar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="1" Background="{StaticResource Color.Surface}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource Color.Border}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="24,0">
                <TextBlock Text="Interval:" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                <TextBox Text="{Binding RefreshInterval}" Width="40" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,16,0"/>
                
                <Button Content="Toggle Service" Command="{Binding ToggleRefreshCommand}" Padding="12,4" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                <Button Content="Sample Data" Command="{Binding SampleCommand}" Padding="12,4"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- 3. Main Content Area -->
        <ScrollViewer Grid.Row="2" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
            <Grid Margin="{StaticResource Grid.Medium}">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Top Section: Summary & Signals -->
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- Bottom Section: Logs -->
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <!-- Upper Section -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="0">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                    <!-- Left Side: Summary / Status Card -->
                    <Border Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                        <DockPanel>
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Engine Summary" Margin="0,0,0,16"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="System is healthy. All channels active." HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#999"/>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- Right Side: Signal Grid Card -->
                    <Border Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                        <DockPanel>
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Text="Active Signals (Grid)" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                            <TabControl BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent">
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 1001"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel1001}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 1002"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel1002}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 3001"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel3001}"/></TabItem>
                                <TabItem Header="CNO 3002"><uc:UCXSignalView DataContext="{Binding Channel3002}"/></TabItem>
                            </TabControl>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Border>
                </Grid>

                <!-- Lower Section: Real-time Radar (Message Logs) -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,8,0,0">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Text="Telegram Radar" Style="{StaticResource Text.Header}" Margin="8,16,8,8"/>

                    <UniformGrid Grid.Row="1" Columns="4">
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="1001: GlobalGold" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog1001}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="1002: GMK" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog1002}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="3001: XHANA" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog3001}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource CardStyle}" Height="350">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="3002: XDUNA" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                <uc:UCXTGMsgView DataContext="{Binding MsgLog3002}"/>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>
                    </UniformGrid>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </ScrollViewer>
    </Grid>
</UserControl>

대시보드 상단 메뉴 클릭 시 **동일 윈도우 내에서 `DataManagerView`가 오픈**되도록 아키텍처를 개선했다.

### 수행 내역

1.  **Shell 아키텍처 도입 (`MainWindow` 리팩토링)**
    *   `MainWindow.xaml`을 전체 서비스의 껍데기(Shell)로 전환했다.
    *   **상단 바 전역화**: 기존 `DashboardView` 내부에 있던 네비게이션 바를 `MainWindow`로 이동시켜, 어떤 화면에서도 메뉴 이동이 가능하도록 했다.
    *   **View switching**: `ContentControl`과 `DataTemplate`을 사용하여 `CurrentView` 값에 따라 대시보드와 데이터 매니저가 교체 출력되도록 구현했다.

2.  **`MainViewModel` 신규 생성 (`ATSA\ATSA\UI\Main`)**
    *   전체 애플리케이션의 상태와 화면 전환 명령(`ShowDashboardCommand`, `ShowDataManagerCommand`)을 관리한다.
    *   화면 전환 시마다 새로운 인스턴스를 생성하거나 기존 상태를 유지하는 등의 확장이 용이하다.

3.  **컴포넌트 정리**
    *   `DashboardView.xaml`: 중복된 상단 네비게이션 바를 제거하고 순수 대시보드 컨텐츠만 남겼다.
    *   `DataManagerView.xaml`: 독립적인 UserControl로 유지되어 Shell 내부로 깔끔하게 삽입된다.

### 결과
*   **작동**: 대시보드 상단 "Data Manager" 클릭 시 별도 창이 뜨지 않고, **현재 창의 내용이 데이터 관리 화면으로 전환**된다. "Dashboard" 클릭 시 다시 복귀한다.
*   **빌드**: 성공 (`ATSA.dll`).

이제 현대적인 단일 창 네비게이션 구조로 변경됐다. 다음 단계 시켜라.
